prompt: Create one complete horizontal 16:9 medieval leaded STAINED-GLASS artwork, one coherent scene. The ENTIRE image must be made of translucent colored glass pieces separated by clearly visible dark lead cames: faces, hands, robes, objects, terrain and sky. Lead seams cross inside faces along forehead, brows, nose bridge, cheekbones and jaw; 10-16 facial panes, not smooth painted skin inside a stained-glass border. Believable natural anatomy and subtle expression, not cartoon, not photorealistic painting. Jewel-toned handmade glass, uneven texture, directional transmitted light with readable shadows. Environment and figures one continuous perspective, no comic panels or webpage cards. Keep key faces, hands and props within central 80% of image. No text, no lettering, no readable runes, no watermark, no logos, no crosses or unrelated religious imagery.  Theme subtitle for semantic guidance ONLY, do not draw words: 自由之后，如何使用力量. Single documented scene before Thrall inherits armor or Doomhammer: young green orc Thrall, blue eyes, black hair and no beard, kneels in an orc internment camp among weary adult orc prisoners. He has coaxed a small seed to sprout and flower before them; show a tiny living sprout growing from a small handful of dirt in his open palm, prisoners slowly looking up with quiet wonder. Plain unadorned worn cloth clothing and a modest camp enclosure AT MIDNIGHT, guards asleep in distant posts, dim cool night light, no grand magical explosion. NO Doomhammer, NO chief armor, NO throne. Warm living green and pale amber emerge among muted grey panes. Hope beginning to restore the will to act.
